title: Vision and Blueprint Worker
description: Image-to-schematic worker log with concrete command invocations, output paths, and stdout-style reconstruction notes.

messages.text: Mounted input image at workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png. Writing vision outputs to workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001/vision and block exports to workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001/blueprint.
messages.systemLog: vision-blueprint INFO read image size=1536x864 mode=RGB exif=none sha256=8f41b07c...

messages.text: Manual check before tool calls: front face is usable; back side is not visible. I marked the roof lip, entrance lanterns, and right-side trim as low-confidence zones.
messages.systemLog: vision-blueprint DEBUG cues saved to vision/cues.json: footprint=oval-ish, symmetry_axis=x0, tiers=3, occluded_faces=back,north-east

messages.text: Calling TRELLIS from the run folder: reconstruct mesh from the single image with seed 2147 and write mesh.obj plus camera.json.
TRELLIS returned a usable mesh, but the curved roof edge is noisy. I am keeping the silhouette and simplifying unsupported overhangs before voxelizing.
messages.systemLog: vision-blueprint WARN mesh review: vertices=184216 faces=368192 watertight=false; roof_lip_noise=0.31; wrote vision/mesh_review.json

messages.text: Calling obj2schematic to voxelize mesh.obj into a Minecraft grid with the project palette and 0.42 block tolerance.
Exporting the schematic into sorted block placements, layer numbers, and region bounds so the planner can split it without reading the binary schem file.
Sanity check passed: every row has x/y/z/material/source. I left 23 low-confidence placements in uncertain_edges.json instead of pretending they are confirmed.
messages.systemLog: vision-blueprint INFO validate placements rows=9274 materials=18 bbox=(-24,63,-18)..(24,95,21) uncertain=23

messages.text: Vision job complete. Returning placements.jsonl, stage_preview.schem, mesh_review.json, and cues.json to the planner queue.
